want: open sea ambience: gentle waves and light wind out on the water, no boats, no voices
heard: Continuous ocean surf ambience: rolling low-frequency wave rumble with periodic swells that build and fade, layered over a steady mid-to-high wind hiss. The waves sound large and moderately distant — more like surf heard from a shoreline or just offshore than choppy open water. There is no discrete tail; the swells decay naturally into the wind bed over a couple of seconds before the next one builds. No voices, no boats, no birds, no debris impacts.
sounds_like: Standing on a windy beach listening to ocean surf rolling in.
problems: The wave swells read as breaking shore surf rather than the subtle, undulating slop of true open sea — the low-end boom may feel too heavy for 'gentle waves out on the water' and could imply land nearby. Wind is present but leans toward a steady hiss rather than light, gusty open-air wind. Otherwise clean, loop-friendly, and free of the forbidden elements.
